summary: Completed comprehensive testing of TS Operator Minion v1 - internal page ops management system. Tested authentication, dashboard, page management, AI generation/scoring, and settings functionality.

minor_bugs.issue: Returns HTTP 200 instead of 201 for page creation
minor_bugs.impact: Minor - functionality works correctly but status code inconsistent with REST standards

design_issues.issue: Logout functionality not clearly visible in UI

passed_tests: Dashboard loads with accurate stats (28 total pages, 0 ready for review, 0 needs rewrite, avg score 72)
Recommended Next pages list displays 5 pages with priority scores
Page Queue displays filtered/sortable page list with search, status, and family filters
Create new page modal works with all form fields
Page Workspace loads page details correctly
Generate Content button works with GPT-5.2 (takes ~30 seconds)
Score Content button works with Claude Sonnet 4.5 (takes ~30 seconds)
Approval actions (Approve, Rewrite, Defer) update page status correctly
Settings page displays and saves scoring thresholds
All API endpoints respond correctly (14/15 tests passed)
Authentication flow works with httpOnly cookies
Activity logging tracks all user actions
Ecosystem data endpoints provide page families, types, and statuses
